bio.text: Matt Blumenthal, of Stamford, assumed office in the Connecticut House of Representatives in 2019.
Blumenthal served as an infantry officer in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve, commanding a rifle platoon in Charlie Company, First Battalion, Twenty-Fifth Marines.
Blumenthal earned an undergraduate degree from Harvard University and a law degree from Yale University, and is a trial attorney at Koskoff, Koskoff & Bieder, P.C.
